title: 我叫古铁雷斯
overview: My Name Is Gutiérrez is written by Jesús Braceras & Gabriel Nicoli and stars Darío Barassi, Yayo Guridi, Juliana Savioli, Lucas Molina, Abian Vainstein, Victor López, Robi Surra and Andrew Vezey. The crime comedy follows the titular Deputy Commissioner as he competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.
